## 5. QA Checklist - CRM Load

1. Apply global suppression (615) and exclude all non-Denver D; load only 17,363 emails / 4,772 SMS.
2. Verify D = 248 emails / 52 SMS Denver ZIPs only; confirm deliverability in Denver metro.
3. Assign one code per customer (A18/B15/C15/D18/E15); block stacking.
4. SMS only to opt-ins, staggered 12-5pm local (8am-9pm rule), includes brand + `Reply STOP to opt out`, ≤160 chars.
5. Stagger emails 9am local by ET/CT/MT/PT; set exit on order, unsubscribe, hard bounce.
6. Confirm C creative cites new recipes + 35% fewer complaints; confirm cost ≤$18/reactivated.
